description: This file defines the MismatchedSetException class, which extends RecognitionException, representing a specific kind of exception thrown during parsing when a set of expected tokens does not match the input.

classes.name: MismatchedSetException
classes.description: An exception class used to indicate a mismatch in expected token sets during parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the expected value and input source.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, indicating the unexpected type and expected value.
